sizePolicy.note: nginx plus the built bundle; the nginx base is most of it

persistence.note: Sidebar state, theme and locale only. Conversation data lives in AI Host; losing this storage loses preferences, not user content.

sizePolicy.note: the node base image dominates; the app layer is one bundled file

persistence.note: SQLite: conversations, timeline, messages and provider configuration. The workbench holds no durable copy, so this is the only record.

sizePolicy.note: node runtime plus the SPA and the API server

persistence.note: SQLite under ZEUS_ADMIN_DATA_DIR. A rollback that restores the previous image must also restore the volume, or the older binary meets a newer schema.

products.sandboxNote: The same image serves the untrusted preview on :81. The sandbox server sends `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts`, which is what gives the iframe its opaque origin; host and sandbox must be different origins in production.

sizePolicy.note: nginx plus the built bundle. The wasm compiler is 1.55 MB raw but 480 kB gzip and is cached separately by the browser; React and Vue vendor chunks belong to the WebC studio preview, not the main path.

persistence.note: Projects and files in IndexedDB, settings in LocalStorage, both keyed by the host origin. IndexedDB is per-origin: a rollback that changes the origin shows an empty workspace rather than migrated data, which is why the rehearsal keeps the origin stable.

products.buildArgsNote: The sandbox is a second origin served from the same image. Left unset, the application derives it from location.port + 1, which is wrong behind any port mapping or reverse proxy: the host frames an origin that is not listening and the preview is blocked by frame-src. The Dockerfile refuses to build without them.

ai.note: The workbench and its host upgrade together: the proxy contract and the token are shared, so a version skew between them is a broken deployment, not a degraded one.

admin.note: Admin is independent of the AI unit and carries its own database.

playground.note: The trusted host and the untrusted sandbox are one deployment: they share an image and the sandbox only means anything from its own origin. Deployed together, rolled back together.
